related.title: IEEE 802.11a OFDM：符元到資訊位元的換算
related.titleEn: IEEE802.11a OFDM: symbols to information bits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 50 ms 與 90 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 50 ms and 90 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋12 Mbit/s與24 Mbit/s，建立wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界，並完成以下驗收：18 Mbit/s PHY教學目標只第二配置滿足；若SNR不支援16QAM則必須降需求。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 12 Mbit/s and 24 Mbit/s; create wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second meets an18 Mbit/s PHY target; reduce demand if SNR cannot support16QAM.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 控制動作使用的狀態年齡包含採樣、傳送、決策及施作延遲；高頻輸出不代表輸入新鮮。 展開基準式 20+10+15+5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以measurement_id、event_time、receive_time、action_time串接；排除重複樣本後計年齡。 將兩條推導一起存入 ric_event_trace.csv、資料年齡直方圖、回退決策。

從原理 名義資訊率由資料子載波數、調變位元、碼率與符元時間決定；前導與競爭會再降低MAC有效率。 展開基準式 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算每符元48與96資訊bit，再數一秒250000符元；確認導頻未算成資料。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from State age at actuation includes sampling, transport, decision and actuation delay; frequent outputs do not guarantee fresh inputs., expand baseline expression 20+10+15+5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Join measurement_id, event_time, receive_time and action_time, deduplicate, then compute state age. Save both derivations with ric_event_trace.csv, state-age histogram and fallback decisions.

Starting from Nominal information rate depends on data subcarriers, modulation bits, code rate and symbol duration; preambles and contention reduce MAC goodput., expand baseline expression 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compute48/96 information bits per symbol then250000 symbols per second; pilots must not count as data. Save both derivations with wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 企業 Wi-Fi Roaming：掃描、驗證與切換時間
related.titleEn: Enterprise Wi-Fi roaming: scan, authentication and transition timing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 50 ms 與 90 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 50 ms and 90 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋80 ms與45 ms，建立roam_events.csv、分段中斷表、裝置能力證據，並完成以下驗收：50 ms中斷預算僅快切換例通過；記錄裝置支援與安全模式，不能承諾所有手機同結果。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 80 ms and 45 ms; create roam_events.csv, phase-delay table and client-capability evidence; apply this acceptance decision: Only the fast example fits50 ms; record client support and security mode rather than promising identical behavior on all phones.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 控制動作使用的狀態年齡包含採樣、傳送、決策及施作延遲；高頻輸出不代表輸入新鮮。 展開基準式 20+10+15+5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以measurement_id、event_time、receive_time、action_time串接；排除重複樣本後計年齡。 將兩條推導一起存入 ric_event_trace.csv、資料年齡直方圖、回退決策。
從原理 漫遊中斷由掃描、驗證與重新關聯等串接步驟構成；快切換只能縮短其中部分。 展開基準式 30+40+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以事件名稱與單調時間戳量測每段；最後舊AP封包到新AP首包需涵蓋全部空隙。 將兩條推導一起存入 roam_events.csv、分段中斷表、裝置能力證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from State age at actuation includes sampling, transport, decision and actuation delay; frequent outputs do not guarantee fresh inputs., expand baseline expression 20+10+15+5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Join measurement_id, event_time, receive_time and action_time, deduplicate, then compute state age. Save both derivations with ric_event_trace.csv, state-age histogram and fallback decisions.

Starting from Roaming interruption includes scanning, authentication and reassociation; fast transition only shortens some components., expand baseline expression 30+40+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Measure named phases with monotonic timestamps; last-old-AP to first-new-AP timing must include all gaps. Save both derivations with roam_events.csv, phase-delay table and client-capability evidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
